title: CTF Challenge Deploy Configuration
description: Configuration file for deploying CTF challenges to Cloudflare

name.description: Display name for the challenge. Defaults to folder name if not specified.

enabled.description: Whether this challenge should be deployed. Set to false to skip deployment.

type.description: Cloudflare deployment type. Use 'pages' for static sites and most web apps, 'worker' for serverless functions.

framework.description: The framework used by the challenge. Affects build process.

deploy_directory.description: Directory containing the deployable application (relative to challenge folder).

output_directory.description: Directory containing built files (relative to deploy_directory). Used for static deployments.

domain.description: Custom domain for the challenge (must be configured in Cloudflare).

subdomain.description: Subdomain prefix when using custom domain.

env.description: Environment variables for build and runtime.

secrets.description: List of GitHub secret names to inject as environment variables.

compatibility_date.description: Cloudflare Workers compatibility date (for worker type only).

node_version.description: Node.js version to use for building.
